params.name: oldest-time
params.description: Constrain the transaction history request to transactions with effective time at or after this date/time. If absent defaults to _newest-time_ minus 90 days. Format is aligned to [DateTimeString](#common-field-types) common type.

params.name: newest-time
params.description: Constrain the transaction history request to transactions with effective time at or before this date/time. If absent defaults to today. Format is aligned to [DateTimeString](#common-field-types) common type.

params.name: min-amount
params.description: Filter transactions to only transactions with amounts higher than or equal to this amount.

params.name: max-amount
params.description: Filter transactions to only transactions with amounts less than or equal to this amount.

params.name: text
params.description: Filter transactions to only transactions where this string value is found as a substring of either the _reference_ or _description_ fields. Format is arbitrary ASCII string. This parameter is optionally implemented by data holders. If it is not implemented then a response should be provided as normal without text filtering applied and an additional boolean field named _isQueryParamUnsupported_ should be included in the meta object and set to `true` (whether the text parameter is supplied or not).

params.name: plan-status
params.description:
Allows for the filtering of plans based on their schedule status:
  • `ACTIVE` requests plans where one or more scheduled instalments have _isPaid_ equal to `false`,
  • `INACTIVE` requests plans where all scheduled instalments have _isPaid_ equal to `true`,
  • `ALL` requests all `ACTIVE` and `INACTIVE` plans.

items.docs: Obtain instalment plans for a single specified account. The response **MUST** be ordered by plan _creationDate_ in descending order. If _isInstalmentDetailAvailable_ was specified as `true` for the provided _accountId_ but no plans match the provided parameters, an empty array **MUST** be returned. If _isInstalmentDetailAvailable_ was specified as `false` for the provided _accountId_, then the endpoint **MAY** respond with [404 - Resource Not Implemented](#error-404-resource-not-implemented).
